echoParts: Today in the city of David
a Savior has been born to you
verseText: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
meaning: This is how the angels let the shepherds know that Jesus the savior was born in Bethlehem.

recall.question: What wonderful news did the angels announce to the shepherds?
choices: Their lost sheep had been found

meaning.question: The word “Savior” means someone who rescues others. What did Jesus come to save us from?

application.prompt: The birth of Jesus is more than a cute Christmas story. It's the start of the greatest rescue story ever: how God's Son saved the world from sin! How does knowing why Jesus came make Christmas even more special?
